static_traits.name: Wang Dawei
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends grow tense from avoiding food-related gatherings
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly and can describe events concretely; attitude is negative

basic_info.main_problem: After burning food at a recent dinner party for friends, experiencing strong helplessness and self-inadequacy about cooking, thus Avoiding cooking and relying on takeout instead.
basic_info.core_demands: The event triggered strong inferiority and inadequacy, affecting self-confidence, hence seeking counseling to relieve such feelings and recover confidence.

special_situations.event: Burned the food at a dinner held for friends, an embarrassing scene
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot make the dinner perfect, it means I am a failure/very helpless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely Avoiding cooking, ordering takeout instead to reduce the risk of failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a terrible Chef; I should never cook again

special_situations.event: Strong fear and tension surging whenever Thinking about having to cook or preparing to cook
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make mistakes again, I will be unable to bear the shame and Self-denial failure brings
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing Anxiety and pressure by avoiding cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up again; I will definitely fail

special_situations.event: Friends comforted on the spot saying 'it's okay', but oneself believing they were just being polite
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' approval determines my value; if comfort is mere politeness, it means they really look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing discussion of feelings with friends, avoiding food-related Social gatherings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just humoring me; they think I am terrible

special_situations.event: Recalls friends 'all handling life very well' and compares with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as them, I am a burden/not worthy of sharing feelings with them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not confiding in friends, avoiding becoming a burden
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not deserve to trouble them; I am a burden

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by friends, seen as competent and not humiliated
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged and humiliated after failure and losing the sense of self-worth
defense_goal: Avoiding repeated failure and others' evaluations by Avoiding cooking and food-related socializing, maintaining fragile self-esteem

object_relations.object_representation: Friends are polite but judgmental others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing friends' comfort or others' views of the event
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding others' comfort as superficial politeness, subconsciously believing the other looks down on oneself (transference: projecting inner shame onto others' evaluations)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone but staying inquiring, using open-ended questions and concretizing follow-ups (e.g. 'what makes you feel they are being perfunctory?'), avoiding judgment, Empathically reflecting the shame.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or advised to start cooking again, or facing a task that requires cooking
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing one failure as inevitably recurring and unbearable, believing complete avoidance is the safest choice
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, supportive tone, first acknowledge their stress experience, then guide distinguishing evidence from speculation, using the language of small-step exposure (such as 'what would it be like to start from the simplest step?').

manifestations: Not sharing inadequacy and shame with friends out of embarrassment
outcomes: Decreased sense of self-worth and Increased anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Strongly pursues 'must be perfect' at dinner parties to meet self-set standards
Constraining oneself with 'I should never cook again' after the event

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing shame and inadequacy to friends, turning to self-Repression instead
Avoiding seeking friends' support, bearing it alone and handling pressure by Avoiding cooking

positive_force: Work functioning remains stable (bar Work not yet affected)
Has social support resources (friends to talk with)
negative_force: Perfectionist tendencies lead to excessive self-pressure
Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking maintaining Self-denial
Avoiding cooking and food-related socializing, the problem cycle maintained
Overly concerned about others' evaluations (mind reading, external-validation tendency)

antecedent: Thinking about having to cook or trying to cook
Needs to prepare food for friends or participate in food-related activities
target_behavior.core_reason: The burnt dinner food triggering shame and self-inadequacy, with perfectionism and catastrophic predictions of failing again
target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and shame, reducing present Anxiety and pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Relying on takeout, Daily life affected; Decreased confidence and Negative emotions persisting

antecedent: Friends' dinners or social situations requiring displaying cooking
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged and failing again, shame-driven Self-protection
target_behavior.function: Escaping others' evaluations and the shame after failure
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends, increased Loneliness and inferiority
